body.zh-Hant: 約翰·弗倫奇·康克林畢業於西點軍校1915年班，是美國陸軍工兵出身的軍官。他在第二次世界大戰中先後擔任北非西部特遣隊的首席工兵，以及第3集團軍的工兵長。戰後他以陸軍准將軍階退役。美國軍事時報的榮譽資料庫把他列為陸軍准將，並載有他獲頒的軍功勳章與陸軍優異服役勳章。
body.en: John French Conklin graduated from the US Military Academy at West Point, Class of 1915, and was an engineer officer of the US Army. In the Second World War he served first as Chief Engineer of the Western Task Force in North Africa and later as Engineer of the Third Army. He retired as a US Army brigadier general; the Military Times Hall of Valor lists him as a brigadier general holding the Legion of Merit and the Army Distinguished Service Medal.

heading.zh-Hant: 北非西部特遣隊作戰與首席工兵
heading.en: North Africa campaign: Chief Engineer, Western Task Force

body.zh-Hant: 1942至1943年間，康克林在北非擔任西部特遣隊的首席工兵（Chief Engineer）。這項任務隸屬美軍進入北非的作戰行動，他因為這段期間「傑出而優異的服務」獲頒軍功勳章（Legion of Merit）。來源只寫明職稱、地點與年份，沒有交代他在具體戰鬥中的行動，因此這裡不再另述細節。
body.en: From 1942 to 1943 Conklin served in North Africa as Chief Engineer of the Western Task Force, a US formation engaged in the North African operations. For this service he was awarded the Legion of Merit. The source gives only his title, the place and the years, not his actions in particular engagements, so no further detail is stated here.

citations.quote: as Chief Engineer, Western Task Force, in North Africa from 1942 to 1943
was awarded the Legion of Merit for exceptionally meritorious conduct

heading.zh-Hant: 第3集團軍工兵長與洛林戰役
heading.en: Third Army Engineer and the Lorraine Campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1944年至1945年，康克林擔任第3集團軍的工兵長（Engineer），戰後獲頒陸軍優異服役勳章。陸軍官方戰史《洛林戰役》附錄收錄1944年9月1日的第3集團軍參謀名冊，其中工兵長一欄列的是上校約翰·F·康克林。第3集團軍後來轉入占領德國的任務，該軍的占領期部隊史則記載，工兵部門負責製作集團軍作戰所用的全部地圖。
body.en: From 1944 to 1945 Conklin was Engineer of the Third Army and was later awarded the Army Distinguished Service Medal. The appendix of the official US Army history The Lorraine Campaign lists, in the Third Army staff roster of 1 September 1944, Colonel John F. Conklin as Engineer. The Third Army then turned to occupation duty in Germany; its occupation history records that the Topographical Section of the Engineers provided all maps used by the Army for operational activities.

body.zh-Hant: 特拉斯科特1895年1月9日生於德州查特菲爾德，自1911年起在俄克拉荷馬的小學任教。1917年他入伍，受訓後於8月以預備役騎兵少尉任官，並在10月轉為正規騎兵、升中尉。晉升少校後，他留在騎兵學校當了五年教官；之後從指揮參謀學校畢業，再度留校任教。
body.en: Truscott was born at Chatfield, Texas, on 9 January 1895 and from 1911 taught in small Oklahoma schools. He entered the army in 1917, was commissioned a reserve cavalry second lieutenant in August, and in October was commissioned in the regular cavalry and promoted to first lieutenant. Promoted to major, he remained at the Cavalry School as an instructor for five years, and after graduating from the Command and General Staff School he again stayed on as an instructor.

body.zh-Hant: 1941年12月他晉升臨時上校並被派往蒙巴頓麾下的盟軍聯合參謀部，其後招募並訓練一個遊騎兵（Rangers）旅。1942年8月19日他率遊騎兵參加迪耶普的跨海峽突襲；同年11月又率特遣隊奪取法屬摩洛哥的利奧泰港。1943年3月他出任第3步兵師師長，該師於7月10日在西西里登陸，攻下巴勒莫與墨西拿，9月18日再登陸薩萊諾加強灘頭。
body.en: In December 1941 he joined the Allied combined staff under Lord Louis Mountbatten and then recruited and trained a brigade of Rangers. On 19 August 1942 he led them in the cross-Channel raid on Dieppe, and in November he led a task force in the capture of Port Lyautey in French Morocco. He took command of the 3rd Infantry Division in March 1943; it landed in Sicily on 10 July, led in the capture of Palermo and Messina, and went ashore at Salerno on 18 September.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年1月22日，第3師在安濟奧灘頭登陸；2月特拉斯科特接替盧卡斯指揮第6軍。該軍頂住德軍猛烈反擊後，於5月突破安濟奧灘頭並向羅馬推進。8月15日，第6軍又在法國南岸的聖特羅佩與聖拉斐爾登陸；9月他升臨時中將，並一直留在第6軍直到12月。
body.en: On 22 January 1944 the 3rd Division assaulted the beach at Anzio, and in February Truscott succeeded Lucas in command of VI Corps. After withstanding German counterattacks the corps broke out of the Anzio beachhead in May and drove toward Rome. On 15 August VI Corps landed on the French south coast at St. Tropez and St. Raphael; he was promoted temporary lieutenant general in September and remained with the corps until December.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年12月他被宣布為駐義大利第5集團軍司令。1945年春，第5集團軍發動橫越波河平原的最後大攻勢，4月21日攻占波隆納，直到5月2日德軍投降。同年10月第5集團軍撤編，特拉斯科特接替巴頓指揮第3集團軍，駐守巴伐利亞占領區；1947年10月他自陸軍退役，1965年9月12日在華盛頓去世。
body.en: In December 1944 he was announced as commanding general of the Fifth Army in Italy. In the spring of 1945 it launched its final attack across the Po valley, taking Bologna on 21 April, and continued until the German surrender on 2 May. The Fifth Army was inactivated in October 1945 and Truscott succeeded Patton in command of the Third Army in occupation duty in Bavaria; he retired from the army in October 1947 and died in Washington, D.C., on 12 September 1965.

body.zh-Hant: 馬奇在賓州伊斯頓的拉法葉學院校園裡長大，後來進入西點軍校，1888年畢業，是炮兵軍官。1898年美西戰爭期間，他因在馬尼拉戰役中率炮兵連衝擊碉堡而獲嘉獎；之後在菲律賓戰爭中，他的營緊追阿奎納多，擊斃其衛隊指揮官並俘虜其參謀長，獲阿瑟·麥克阿瑟稱讚。
body.en: March grew up on the campus of Lafayette College in Easton, Pennsylvania, and entered West Point, graduating in the class of 1888 as an artilleryman. In 1898 he was cited for leading his battery in a charge a charge against a blockhouse during the Battle of Manila. In the Philippine war his battalion pursued Aguinaldo, killing the commander of his bodyguard and capturing his chief of staff, and Arthur MacArthur commended his field service.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰：由炮兵主官到陸軍參謀長
heading.en: World War I: from artillery chief to Chief of Staff

body.zh-Hant: 馬奇在6月升准將，赴法擔任第1師炮兵指揮官，三個月後再升一星，出任美國遠征軍的炮兵主官。貝克部長急需他回國，他於3月4日正式就任代理參謀長，同年春天接任美國陸軍參謀長，此後直到1921年6月底退休。
body.en: Promoted brigadier general in June, March joined Pershing as commander of the 1st Division artillery and three months later became chief of artillery of the AEF. Secretary Baker urgently needed him at home, and on 4 March 1918 he formally assumed the post of acting chief of staff; he became the army's chief of staff in the spring of 1918 and served until his retirement at the end of June 1921.

body.zh-Hant: 馬奇上任後壓制各兵種署長的權力，改設採購、儲存與運輸處統籌後勤。1918年8月他以第80號通令明定參謀長是陸軍最高將領，與潘興關於參謀長權限的看法衝突。大戰最後八個月，約180萬美軍運往法國；停戰後他又主持動員解除，並因此以建立參謀長在陸軍中的主導地位而著稱。
body.en: On taking office March curbed the bureau chiefs and created a Purchase, Storage, and Traffic Division to coordinate logistics. In General Order No. 80 of August 1918 he spelled out that the chief of staff was the dominant army officer, which clashed with Pershing. In the war's last eight months almost 1.8 million men went to France, and after the armistice he supervised demobilization; he laid the foundation for the future power of the office.

people.name: Simon Bolivar Buckner Jr.
people.nameZh: 小西蒙·玻利瓦爾·巴克納

body.zh-Hant: 小西蒙·玻利瓦爾·巴克納1886年7月18日生於肯塔基州哈特郡的格倫·利利莊園，父親是南軍中將，後來出任肯塔基州長。他就讀西點軍校，一次大戰期間負責訓練飛行員，戰後以教官聞名，並在1933至1936年擔任西點軍校學員隊長。
body.en: Simon Bolivar Buckner Jr. was born on 18 July 1886 at the Glen Lily estate in Hart County, Kentucky; his father was a Confederate lieutenant general and later governor of Kentucky. He attended West Point, spent World War I training aviators, built a reputation as an educator, and served as Commandant of Cadets at West Point in 1933-1936.

heading.zh-Hant: 阿拉斯加防務與阿留申戰役
heading.en: Alaska Defense Command and the Aleutians

body.zh-Hant: 1940年7月22日，巴克納以上校身分抵達安克雷奇，統率阿拉斯加防衛部隊；1941年2月4日該部隊改稱阿拉斯加防衛司令部。1942年6月日軍占領阿留申群島的阿圖與基斯卡，他主張進攻；後來他在總部設於理查森堡的任內主持1942至43年收復阿留申的作戰。1944年6月他離開阿拉斯加，轉赴指揮第10集團軍。
body.en: On 22 July 1940 Buckner arrived in Anchorage as a colonel in command of the Alaska Defense Force, which was redesignated the Alaska Defense Command on 4 February 1941. In June 1942 the Japanese occupied Attu and Kiska, and Buckner wanted to go on the offense; he oversaw the 1942-43 recapture of the Aleutians from headquarters at Fort Richardson. He left Alaska in June 1944 to command the Tenth Army.

body.zh-Hant: 巴克納以第10集團軍司令的身分指揮攻占沖繩，這是他首次真正的戰鬥指揮。1945年6月18日，他在79天激戰的尾聲到陸戰隊第8團的觀察所視察，被日軍炮彈的珊瑚碎片擊中身亡，成為二戰中陣亡的美軍最高階指揮官。指揮權交給陸戰隊少將蓋格，三天後宣布沖繩肅清。
body.en: Buckner commanded the Tenth Army in the assault on Okinawa, his first true combat command. On 18 June 1945, near the end of the long battle, he climbed to an 8th Marine Regiment observation post and was killed when a Japanese barrage sent coral fragments into him, making him the highest-ranking American commander to die from enemy fire in the war. Command went to Marine Major General Roy Geiger, who three days later declared Okinawa secure.

body.zh-Hant: 克魯格1881年1月26日生於德國弗拉托，八歲隨家人移居美國。1898年他以二等兵身分參加美西戰爭，後來升到中士；在菲律賓叛亂期間表現良好，1901年獲任少尉，第二次駐菲時還測繪過日後的戰場——呂宋北部。
body.en: Krueger was born at Flatow, Germany, on 26 January 1881 and was brought to the United States at the age of eight. He enlisted as a private in the Spanish-American War in 1898 and rose to sergeant; he performed so well during the Philippine Insurrection that he was commissioned a second lieutenant in 1901, and on his second Philippine tour he mapped northern Luzon, his future battlefield.

heading.en: World War I and the interwar years

body.zh-Hant: 1916年他在墨西哥邊境任團長；一次大戰時是美軍第26師的作戰官，後來轉任新生坦克兵團的參謀長。戰後他完成陸軍航空兵初級飛行學校、指揮參謀學院與陸軍戰爭學院的訓練；1941年已晉升中將，在聖安東尼奧指揮第3集團軍司令部。
body.en: He was a regimental commander on the Mexican border in 1916, then operations officer of the 26th Infantry Division in France in World War I and later chief of staff of the fledgling American tank corps. After the war he graduated from the Command and Staff College and the Army War College, and by 1941 he was a lieutenant general commanding Third Army headquarters in San Antonio.

heading.zh-Hant: 第6集團軍與新幾內亞作戰
heading.en: Sixth Army and the New Guinea campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 1943年1月11日他被任命為西南太平洋戰區的兩個陸軍野戰指揮官之一，2月7日抵澳洲，指揮第6集團軍。6月30日該軍在新幾內亞的瑙蘇灣完成首次登陸，此後約十八個月實施了二十次成功的兩棲作戰；1943年11月他又設立訓練中心，培養偵察部隊「阿拉莫偵察兵」。
body.en: On 11 January 1943 Lieutenant General Krueger was named one of the two army field commanders in the Southwest Pacific, and he arrived in Australia on 7 February to command the Sixth Army. On 30 June the army made its first amphibious landing at Nassau Bay, New Guinea, and over the next eighteen months conducted twenty successful amphibious operations; in November 1943 Krueger set up a training center for a scout unit called the Alamo Scouts.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年10月20日，第6集團軍在萊特島登陸，只有三十五天的籌劃時間。1945年1月9日，約十七萬五千人在呂宋的林加延一帶登陸，抵抗不大。第6集團軍的作戰涵蓋新不列顛、萊特、民都洛與呂宋；戰後他於1946年1月第6集團軍撤編時退役，返回聖安東尼奧，1967年8月20日在福吉谷去世，葬於阿靈頓國家公墓。
body.en: The Sixth Army landed on Leyte on 20 October 1944 after only thirty-five days of planning, and on 9 January 1945 some 175,000 men landed on Luzon at Lingayen against little Japanese opposition; its fighting also covered New Britain and Mindoro. The Sixth Army was deactivated in January 1946, Krueger retired to San Antonio, and he died at Valley Forge, Pennsylvania, on 20 August 1967 and was buried at Arlington National Cemetery.
